name: recall-cue
description: Points the model, out of the user's sight, at saved notes whose words match the prompt: auto-memory files and any folders you add

extraFolders.title: Extra note folders
extraFolders.description: More folders of Markdown notes to match prompts against, comma-separated (for example ~/notes, ~/work/docs). The auto-memory folder is always read. Empty reads only auto-memory.
